$comment: The widget registry: the fourth kind of thing the package ships, between the components and the templates. One member by design. `parts` names the library components the widget composes (held to src/components/registry.json by scripts/validate-chat-widget.mjs), `subpaths` the package exports it occupies (held to scripts/package-manifest.mjs), `category` the component category whose section and sidebar group its page joins (held to src/components/registry.json), `peers` the optional peer dependencies each subpath needs (held to package.json). The widget's page under /components, the /docs/chat page, the chat corpus and the MCP tools read this file; never type its facts elsewhere.

widgets.name: ChatWidget
widgets.label: AI chat
widgets.description: The whole AI chat: the panel, the streaming replies, the history, the cards and questions a reply can carry and the server handlers, set up with props.

subpaths../chat: The widget, the provider, the launcher and the engine under them.
subpaths../chat/server: The streaming chat handler, with an opt-in tool for asking the visitor questions, and its follow-ups and feedback siblings, for any web-standard route.
subpaths../chat/upstash: Rate limits, a daily budget and the exchange log over Upstash Redis, as the handlers' guardrails.
subpaths../chat/demo: A scripted conversation with rich cards and fixtures, for a preview that needs no key.
